facts.fact: FB Attorneys says Tanzania has no specific law regulating AI or deepfakes, and that the government's AI Strategic Framework acknowledges AI-generated misinformation and deepfakes are not comprehensively addressed in current law.

TZA.note: Nothing on government use of AI.

facts.fact: FB Attorneys says Tanzania does not yet have a specific law regulating AI or deepfake technology.

TZA.note: Nothing on AI in a sector's public system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: FB Attorneys describes Tanzania's Cybercrimes Act as criminalising false or misleading published information (section 16) and cyberbullying (section 23), and setting a take-down notification procedure (section 45).

TZA.note: No dated use of the Act is given.

facts.fact: FB Attorneys says Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Act requires personal data to be collected and processed lawfully, fairly and transparently, with mechanisms for investigation, enforcement and compensation.

TZA.note: No authority, regulation or dated decision is named.
Nothing on public discussion, cuts or punishment.
